m4-tests.imperative: Write tests/test_record_postcondition_wiring.py (test-after allowed; the deliberate-breakage tests ARE the acceptance criteria). Cover: (1) record(pass) on an item with a PASSING command postcondition succeeds, status becomes complete, result pass. (2) DELIBERATE BREAKAGE via verify_interrogation.py: build a scratch record in tmp_path with a self-answered decision (minimal invalid shape per tests/test_interrogation.py), point the item's command postcondition at it, call record(pass) and assert EngineError. Both breakage cases must genuinely invoke the real, unmodified verify scripts (subprocess or direct import -- your call, document which) against real bad files in tmp_path -- never mocked. All fixtures live in tmp_path only. Attest c1 after the file passes.
